{{Quote|Not on this voyage, Mister!|Glaucus|<ref name="AB" />}}
'''Glaucus''' was a retired [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who became the commander of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'', following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
He interrogated a pair of spacers who were arrested after the death of [[Natja]]. After being convinced of their innocence, he released them.<ref name="AB" />

==Personality and traits==
Glaucus was direct and to the point. Despite seeming to be slightly senile, he was actually intelligent and witty.<ref name="AB" />
